name: huella-contributiva
description: Huella Contributiva: a transparency and civic-awareness tool that makes visible every contribution to the Spanish state generated by your work. It reads your own Social Security (Import@ss) and SEPE records read-only with your digital certificate (Chrome + macOS Keychain): work history, contribution bases, quota calculations, paid contributions, unemployment benefit certificates and the self-employed annual regularisation. It builds a combined report and a local dashboard, and exposes everything as a CLI and an MCP server. All data stays on your machine.
